skills.name: fha-denial-statistics
skills.description: Answer questions about US FHA mortgage denial rates (national, state, metro, lender, denial reasons, small-loan penalty) from the complete 2025 federal HMDA record, restating each figure inside its published use contract and carrying its claim receipt. Use when a user asks how often FHA loans are denied, which lenders deny most, why mortgages are denied, or wants a mortgage denial statistic with a verifiable source.
